scope: Read-only source advisory before bounded r3 exact batch; no edits except this advisory, builds/tests/native runs, ratification or qualification.
disposition: No remaining identified blocker in reviewed attribution/consumer corrections. Source advisory only; no conformance execution, exact-output result, performance acceptance or owner authority inferred.

findings.finding: Workload context persists after WindowEvent. Background polling/lifecycle work can later update revisions under stale demand/phase rather than its actual producer. Revisions::update tags every change with that retained context.
findings.required: Scope native demand context; explicitly attribute background/lifecycle changes and render preparation to real causal demand, or fail closed on unknown/unscoped mutation during bounded workload. Preserve pending active work across later exposure/defer; do not optimize scheduling.

findings.finding: Duplicate frames rejected but missing/noncontiguous per-host frame IDs accepted; consumer can validate a strict subset of complete GPU frames.
findings.required: Validate per-host/epoch frame sequence against independently emitted/drained final count or manifest; reject missing first/middle/tail receipts. If existing runner supplies coverage, make that required contract explicit and test it.

findings.source: scripts/gpu_r3_receipts.py:pass interval loop and final graph; gpu_measurements.rs:decode
findings.finding: Individual pass durations and submission endpoints are checked but final internal pass chronology is not. Leading[10,11],restore[20,80],suffix[40,50] with matching durations/span/manifests can pass despite overlapping/reversed ordered passes.
findings.required: Require flattened pass endpoints to be nondecreasing after nested scene removal, in producer and consumer or mandatory consumer; add overlap/reversal negative.

assessment: Cancellation receipts now preserve each submitted id/kind/attempt/workload from pending.timeline, which is updated after each continuation submit. Prior lost-lineage concern addressed.

Consumer now requires nonempty bounded submission manifest, explicit final command graph, leading/trailing upload intervals and matching raw boundaries. It correctly retains active phase in a union and ignores log-arrival time for attribution.

FramePlan snapshots workload tag; continuation manifests retain each submission tag rather than retroactively overwriting earlier causal work. Source/preparation/target lineage checks remain fail-closed.

r3_damage_qualification covers coalesced old/new support, menu overlap, mixed changes, omitted-old-damage/mask/stale-B faults, mask admission pressure and encoded-image eviction. Negatives explicitly require wrong output and exact full recovery; actual sensitivity remains unexecuted.

Mask lifetime control manually holds SubmissionRef, establishing ownership/accounting release semantics, not actual queued mask survival. Image lifetime control submits real copy and uses queue completion. Keep narrow claims and add real queued-mask evidence if claiming that acceptance predicate.

Exact aggregate reuses approved all-sample oracle and prior scene/terminal/Console cases; shared reference painter does not independently verify all scene-preparation semantics. Timing conformance/semantic coverage is separate.
Uninstrumented CPU, full DRM duty and final qualification remain excluded; no paused/stopped r2 run is reclassified or restarted.

review_history.disposition: Three method correctness amendments remain before claiming complete attribution/conformance. No new identified renderer pixel mechanism blocker; independent exact batch usefulness does not imply method acceptance.

followup: Native WindowEvent observation ends workload context after dispatch. Existing about_to_wait dispatch/background processing is enclosed by native_round context; rounds with no revision/attempt change are removed and previous context restored. No scheduling change found.

Unscoped revision changes latch invalid workload attribution; pending() returns zero tag and consumer rejects it. Pending active phase tags still survive subsequent still/drain/close round context until acknowledgement.

Receipt exports renderer drained host/device/next_frame manifest. Consumer restricts all frame identities to this range and requires exact count with unique IDs, preventing missing first/middle/tail samples for native u64 frame IDs. Quiet mode must keep separate no-GPU validation path, since this GPU consumer correctly requires nonempty complete frame range.
Consumer now requires flattened pass ticks nondecreasing, closing final internal overlap/reversal gap. Missing frame and overlapping pass negatives source-inspected.

Cancellation lineage and final upload bracketing remain as prior reviewed. New records count native events plus meaningful rounds against same4096 cap; capacity exhaustion remains explicit invalidity, not permission to retry.
Reviewer did not execute tests/builds/native runs. Existing new sample/resource controls remain unexecuted evidence until parent authorized bounded batch.
